description: This file defines the 'campaign_charts' class which contains methods for generating various campaign-related charts and reports in a SuiteCRM/SugarCRM environment. The class includes methods for campaign response analysis, ROI calculations, and data fetching for chart visualization, involving database queries and chart file management.

classes.name: campaign_charts
classes.description: A class responsible for generating various campaign-related charts and reports, including response metrics and ROI analysis, within the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM environment.

methods.name: campaign_response_by_activity_type
methods.description: Generates a chart showing campaign response by activity type, querying campaign logs and preparing data for visualization.

methods.name: campaign_response_roi
methods.description: Calculates and displays the return on investment (ROI) for a specific campaign, including financial metrics and visualization.

methods.name: campaign_response_roi_data
methods.description: Fetches detailed ROI data for a campaign, suitable for alternative charting (such as RGraph), providing financial and performance metrics.
